title: Does not sit flush to fireplace
text: Does not sit flush to fireplace. The picture was a little deceiving as I thought it would sit flush to the brick on the fireplace, but it was not able to as the feet did extend behind the screen, so it sits about 4" from the brick.  No, I did not read the comments, until just before I posted this review.  That is why I titled it as I have, so it is more apparent.  But looks good.  I would not use it with a fire in the fireplace though, due to the gap. But I bought this for a home that I was selling, so was more concerned that it looked good in place for the house tours.  The box that it was sent is was the retail box, so the screen did take a little abuse, but was not dented.  The bolt or rivet tops, in the front of the screen were rubbed down, but I was able to retouch with a black Sharpie.
